notes.title: Patch Notes 1.20w
notes.content:
•	Horn weapons have been replaced with Hooks (same values but different range).
•	The Root weapon now has magical range (always hits the back row).
•	Weapon upgrades from Faction rewards are now skippable.
•	Unique weapons now roll their speed 0.5 below the weapon’s minimum (not always 0.9–1.1).
•	Fixed a bug where you could delete enough Heroes to lock yourself out of a run.
•	Correctly displays weapon cap at 0.8.
•	Fixed a bug where weapon range was not shown on weapon previews.
•	Fixed some tooltips.
•	Minor UI improvements.

notes.title: Spring Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to share some news about the progress on Stash!

[b]Thank You, Demo Players & Early Testers[/b]
A massive shout-out to everyone who dove into our demo and shared feedback. Your insights have been invaluable, and your excitement keeps us fired up!

[b]Demo Retired & Big Changes Ahead[/b]
With the demo now retired, we’re rolling up our sleeves to implement substantial improvements according to your feedback and our ambitions for the game!
[b]
New Artist Onboard[/b]
All placeholder art is out! We’ve hired the incredibly talented Windsvn (https://www.deviantart.com/windsvn), and we are all hard at work crafting a unique art style that brings our post-human animal realms to life.

[b]Release Date Announcement[/b]
Mark your calendars: Stash: A Card Looter is now scheduled for Fall 2025. We can’t wait for you to experience the full game.

Have questions or just want to chat? Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/vhsJ6xQbfU

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of our journey!

— The Stash Dev Team

notes.title: Major update (patch v0.11)
notes.content:
Major Update just dropped!

This patch brings a wave of improvements and new content to Stash. The focus was on all progression systems and making the UI easier to understand for new players.

Highlights:

[b]Full PC Layout[/b] – The arena and all screens now fully adapt to your display, giving desktop players a cleaner and more immersive experience.

[b]New Rank System[/b] – Matchmaking has been reworked with a new ranking system for fairer, more competitive battles.

[b]Location Cards with Special Events[/b] – New locations cards allow players to explore special events to refine their strategy even more in between some matches.

Steam Achievements – You can now earn Steam achievements as you play.

This is just the beginning and we have some very exciting news to be shared soon.

notes.title: New Update: Quality of Life Improvements!
notes.content:
One of the biggest changes is a new full-screen arena layout for PC players, making the battlefield clearer and more immersive. We’ve also added a lot more tooltips to help new and returning players understand the game faster, with key mechanics and interactions now easier to grasp at a glance. Additionally, a speed slider has been introduced, allowing you to slow down or speed up the action so you can analyze battles at your own pace.

Beyond these major changes, we’ve made a number of smaller quality-of-life improvements to streamline gameplay and make everything feel smoother.

We’re also looking ahead to the next patch, which will introduce special events—we can’t wait to share more soon![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354231/9220b64b2d1f9b766691dab7b61b8c86d3c22e55.png[/img]

notes.title: First Demo of Stash: A Card Looter
notes.content:
After a long journey of development, we are beyond excited to finally let you get hands-on with Stash: A Card Looter! Just in time for NextFest, our first Demo is live on Steam!

We can’t wait to hear the stories of insane combos, game-breaking synergies, and strategies that push the limits of our vast, randomized card pool. Be the first to discover truly unique weapons and legendary heroes!

We’re also happy to share that you [b]no longer need to create an account[/b] to jump into the action. Originally, accounts were meant to support cross-platform play, but we’ll tackle that challenge in a better way when the time comes. For now, we just want you to dive in and have fun!

This is just the beginning, and your feedback will help shape the future of Stash. Join the conversation in our forums—it's still pretty quiet, so your voice will truly make a difference. Let’s build something amazing together!

See you in the game!
